seo.title: About Mike Madsen — Las Vegas Photographer | VTLV
seo.description: Meet Mike Madsen, Las Vegas real estate photographer since 2006 — licensed agent, FAA Part 107 drone pilot and Google Trusted Photographer serving Las Vegas.

hero.title: You're hiring me. Not a middleman.
hero.lead: Most real estate photo companies are middlemen who outsource your listing to whoever's closest. Virtual Tours Las Vegas is one photographer, Mike Madsen, and I shoot, edit and deliver every property myself.
hero.imageAlt: Modern Las Vegas kitchen photographed by Mike Madsen

story.title: From bank-owned listings to building VTLV.
paragraphs: I've been in real estate since {business.realEstateSince} — first as a licensed agent, then as the marketing lead overseeing the sale of bank-owned properties through the recession. That work earned me Sales & Marketing recognition from the Wall Street Journal and Realtor.com, and it's where I learned what actually moves a listing.

When the bank-owned market wound down, I launched Virtual Tours Las Vegas in {business.since}. I've shot thousands of properties, from one-bedroom condos to mansions with indoor basketball gyms. Along the way, **I was the photographer for the Zillow Offers program in Las Vegas** (that program ended in 2021), and **I provided Matterport services for builders like Lennar Homes**.

Once, I shot HDR photos and 360s for eight houses in a single day. I've also spent two straight days documenting a single mansion. Every property gets the same standard: straight walls, real colors, no blown-out windows.

I shoot on a mirrorless DSLR, hold a Part 107 drone license, and am a Google Street View Trusted photographer. I still hold my real estate license too, and started the business with my wife Michelle Sproul, a licensed Realtor. I understand listings because I've been on that side of the desk.

approach.title: "I get behind my mirrorless DSLR and let the camera tell me what it wants to see."
approach.lead: My philosophy is simple: everything starts with the photos. A great 3D tour, social reel, or floor plan only matters if the underlying imagery is right. I treat every shoot like a 24/7 open house, because that's what it is to the buyer who clicks through at midnight.

cards.title: One photographer, one standard
cards.body: No rotating cast of subcontractors. I capture and deliver every shoot myself: the same eye, the same edit, the same accountability, every time.

cards.title: Real-estate native
cards.body: A licensed agent who's marketed and sold real estate. I understand MLS workflow, listing strategy and what actually makes a buyer click, because I've done it myself.

cards.title: Equipment & craft
cards.body: Mirrorless DSLR capture, professional HDR processing, Matterport 3D scanning, FAA-certified aerial work. I keep refining the craft, the same approach I picked up studying photography fundamentals years ago.

cards.title: Fast & reliable
cards.body: 24–48 hour standard delivery, MLS-ready formats, embed codes included. Rush next-morning delivery when a listing needs to go live fast.
